evidence.scope: GEPTIS: BBMP municipality; Dishaank: Karnataka village and subdivision records with incomplete finer geometry
evidence.conclusion: Dishaank may show suburban survey plots, while GEPTIS may show urban taxable properties. Neither supplies a verified anonymous polygon list near Bengaluru, and the two geometries must not be treated as equivalent.

portals.name: Karnataka Bhoomi/Dishaank
portals.observation: Official KSRSAC developer app listing says Dishaank displays survey and hissa boundaries and RTC details; a Karnataka government presentation (2024) says all 33,000 village map sheets with whole survey numbers were digitized/georeferenced and exposed for public viewing through rdservices.karnataka.gov.in, while hissa/subdivision maps were 61% georeferenced at that presentation date and available through Dishaank. The current Dishaank/BhoomiMaps web routes were not reachable from the tested network; this does not prove service absence.

portals.name: KSRSAC Dishaank digitized-map coverage documentation
portals.operator: Karnataka State Remote Sensing Applications Centre / Karnataka government
portals.observation: Government presentation says 100% of village maps (whole survey numbers) were scanned, digitized and georeferenced and made available through rdservices.karnataka.gov.in for public viewing; hissa/subdivision maps were 61% georeferenced at time of report and made available through Dishaank. This establishes a government map program, not an anonymous machine-readable feature endpoint or city-specific completeness.

portals.name: Greater Bengaluru Authority GIS Viewer
portals.operator: Greater Bengaluru Authority, Government of Karnataka
portals.observation: Search-indexed UI lists Corporation/Zone/Old Ward selectors and street/satellite basemaps; it does not show a parcel layer in the returned interface text. Direct HTTP viewer/index requests timed out, so JavaScript/network configuration could not be inspected.

portals.observation: Official document describes tax-property mapping and PID/ward/street/plot IDs; public viewer needs mobile-linked registration and limits number of viewed properties. Not an anonymous cadastral vector source; no registration or owner data accessed.

technicalDiscoveryChecks.method: Official site and web-app UI discovery
technicalDiscoveryChecks.observation: Official Greater Bengaluru Authority GIS Viewer is indexed with search selectors for Corporation, Zone and Old Ward and base layers OpenStreetMap/Google imagery/street maps. This is administrative GIS UI content; no cadastral parcel layer is listed in the returned UI text. Search cache is not direct HTTP verification.

technicalDiscoveryChecks.method: Direct ordinary GET to official viewer and Karnataka cadastral portal endpoints; escalated network request with browser UA, redirects allowed, connect timeout 8 s/read timeout 18 s
technicalDiscoveryChecks.result: All six requests raised ConnectTimeout before an HTTP response. A follow-up to both Karnataka map routes over ordinary HTTP also raised ConnectTimeout. This is network reachability failure from this route, not evidence that the source is unavailable globally.

technicalDiscoveryChecks.observation: Official BBMP IT page describes GEPTIS as municipal property-tax GIS with PID (ward/street/plot) identifiers. Its public view requires mobile-linked registration, is view-limited, and distinguishes tax details from ownership data. No anonymous reusable parcel-vector endpoint is documented; no registration/account or owner record was used.

technicalBlocker: No geometry was obtained. Escalated ordinary GET attempts to the official Dishaank, Karnataka BhoomiMaps, KSRSAC and GBA GIS Viewer routes all ended in ConnectTimeout before HTTP response. The search-indexed GBA viewer exposes admin selectors; the official GEPTIS public view requires mobile-linked registration. These are specific access/interface findings, not evidence that no Karnataka data exists.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the public Dishaank mobile app serves anonymous map tiles or vector features at the exact WUP coordinate remains unknown because the web endpoints could not be inspected. Village-map whole-survey digitization is documented at statewide level, but hissa availability is incomplete and no city-specific response/completeness was verified.
nextStep: Retry the official Dishaank/BhoomiMaps viewer from a functioning ordinary browser route and inspect its public map requests with a bounded exact-coordinate view; do not assume hissa coverage from statewide whole-map statistics.
